passages.provision_quote: Following the implementation of the minimum wage increase specified in subparagraph (F) of paragraph (2) of subdivision (b), on or before August 1 of that year, and on or before each August 1 thereafter, the Director of Finance shall calculate an adjusted minimum wage.
passages.note: SB 3 raises the minimum wage by a set schedule to $15 per hour, then requires an automatic annual CPI-W adjustment each year after that with no new legislation.
Senate Floor concurrence vote on SB 3 passed Ayes 26 to Noes 12, with Allen listed among the Ayes.
passages.actor_quote: Ayes Allen, Beall, Block, De León, Galgiani, Glazer, Hall, Hancock, Hernandez, Hertzberg, Hill, Hueso, Jackson, Lara, Leno, Leyva, Liu, McGuire, Mendoza, Mitchell, Monning, Pan, Pavley, Roth, Wieckowski, Wolk

rows.reasoning: SB 3 (2015-2016) raises the minimum wage by a set schedule to fifteen dollars per hour and then requires the Director of Finance to calculate an adjusted minimum wage each year thereafter by CPI-W, matching rung 1, 'Raise the wage floor and tie it to the cost of living, so it rises automatically each year without new legislation,' and excluding rung 2 because no further legislative vote is needed once the index takes over. Allen voted Aye on the Senate concurrence vote.
